feeds.title: UpBeat Barre Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about Barre, fitness, choreography, how barre can help you and much more! Four Barre Instructors, seeing each other's unique strengths and talents, came together in a collaboration to bring their classes beyond the gym and outside their homes. Now, instructors can use unique, structured, to-the-beat barre choreography for their own classes; and participants can work out in their own homes with barre tracks designed by top instructors.

feeds.title: Power Life Blog
feeds.description: Power Life is about making your healthy lifestyle what you want it to be. We are a place to meet friends, a place to meet goals and a place to meet yourself. At Power Life, there is a spot for everyone and a style of exercise for everybody. Explore our blog for health advice, fitness, lifestyle and more!

feeds.title: Physique 57 Blog
feeds.description: Check out Physique 57's Blog to get dietary tips, form guidance, lifestyle advice, and more! Physique 57 is an international fitness and media company, founded by former Wall Street professional, Jennifer Vaughan Maanavi, and wellness expert, Tanya Becker. Their method embraces a more intimate, dynamic workout environment, incorporating rigorous interval training and creative choreography.

feeds.title: Barre3 Blog
feeds.description: Barre3 is a fitness company comprised of 130+ studios around the globe; 250+ streamable online workouts; wellness retreats held throughout the year; a thriving digital magazine; and thoughtfully curated retail products. Through fostering a culture of good health, barre3 is a community where every individual can feel balanced in body and empowered from within. Learn more on Barre and how it can help your body.

feeds.title: Barre 2 Barre Blog
feeds.description: Barre 2 Barre isn't just a regular studio for your barre workout, it's a comprehensive fitness lifestyle that offers a variety of different classes for anyone at any level. We infuse the mind/body connection into every class we carefully curate. Know more about our workshops, fitness tips, health and more!

feeds.title: The Dailey Method Blog
feeds.description: The Dailey Method combines the best of Pilates, yoga, and barre fitness training. Classes are an ever-evolving mix of movements that offer benefits for the body and mind. Our method is driven by fitness research and our students' needs. Learn more about our training courses, healthy lifestyle, fitness tips and more!

feeds.title: Aleenta Health Club Blog
feeds.description: Read about workouts, health and fitness, our clients and more on the Aleenta Health. Aleenta is a health club like no other. A grown-ups only playground that feeds your soul with fun, your body with energy and your mind with happiness.

feeds.title: The Barre Collective Blog
feeds.description: Discover and learn about this transformative method of exercise and delve into the world of Barre and Ballet Fitness with our Barre Journals. The Barre Collective is the world's first exhaustive resource for Barre Instructors and Barre devotees alike. Barre Collective brings together the very best barre workouts, on one platform and by invitation, allowing you to search for high-quality workouts with Instructors hand-picked by us.

feeds.title: Pilates Barre and Sports Massage Blog
feeds.description: I initially set up my business with the sole purpose of teaching Pilates. As an ex-gym fanatic, I did however recognize that for some people Pilates may not be challenging enough and that is where my interest in Barre began. Explore my blog to know more about my workshops, barre, pilates and more!

feeds.title: Barre and Brunch
feeds.description: Here is where you can find the recipes and workouts I've created, as well as blog posts on wellness and my life. Sharing ways to live a healthy and mindful lifestyle that is affordable, efficient, and inclusive. I am from a small town called Stillwater, Minnesota and graduated in May of 2019 from Boston University, where I studied Chemistry and minored in French, Biology, and Dance. I am currently in my fourth year of medical school in downtown Chicago.

feeds.title: Barre Body Studio Blog
feeds.description: Visit our blog to get studio and class updates, news and information. We will be updating this section with useful and interesting content, so check back often. Barre Body Studio is a boutique fitness studio offering barre and mat based classes.

feeds.title: Barre Where You Are Blog
feeds.description: Barre Where You Are is unlike any other Barre class you have ever heard of. We are taking Barre outside of the studio and bringing it to YOU! BWYA is making it easier than ever to fit your favorite workout into your everyday life - Anytime, Anyplace for Anyone! Explore our Baree Blog to know more about our services, what is barre, how it can help and more!

feeds.title: Ohana Yoga » Barre
feeds.description: Read our blog for our latest insight on the Ohana lifestyle and barre. Ohana Yoga + Barre is more than just a fitness studio. We're a community of like-minded individuals passionate about personal development and connection. Join us to experience networking groups, special events, and in-depth trainings.

feeds.title: The Barre Pianist Blog
feeds.description: Learning about music structure, in a way that resonates with ballet teachers! Lorel Leal is a top notch ballet accompanist extraordinaire who is dedicated to leaving the studio a happier and more pleasant place than when she went in. By playing 'fun' and unusual songs that everyone knows interspersed by classical favourites, Lorel brings a smile to each dancer and teacher's face as she enters the ballet studio.

feeds.title: Barre Vida Blog
feeds.description: Everything you want to know about Barre, Barre Vida, Barre Instructor Training, Health, Wellness, and more! Barre Vida is a Barre Instructor Certification Program, offering Online and In-Person training for every Body. Barre Vida is a total body workout open to women and men of all fitness levels, blending the original Lotte Berk method with exercise science, Pilates, and dance.

feeds.title: Sharing the Barre Blog
feeds.description: Learn how to be the best you with articles on how to develop confidence, tips and tricks for auditioning, fashion tips, discussing topics in dance and so much more in Sharing the Barre's blog. Sharing the Barre finally breaks the trend of designing for an 'ideal dancer', and instead creates dancewear that fits dancers through our innovative versatile designs. Sharing the Barre will empower you to feel confident about yourself and abilities, and as a result you will glow during class, at a convention, or auditioning for a leading role.

feeds.title: Groove Barre Blog
feeds.description: Musings from a fledging barre boss as I open the first dedicated barre studio in Markham. Everything from favourite recovery methods to must-share recipes! Groove Barre is Markham's only dedicated barre studio. We deliver the perfect blend of ballet, yoga, and Pilates fusion to sculpt long lean muscles.

feeds.title: Barre Effect Blog
feeds.description: Founded by Nora Hameidani, the Barre Effect method is a contemporary version on traditional barre, designed to sculpt your body, boost your metabolism, and challenge your mind. Our blog features articles on fitness, barre training, our workshops and schedules and more!

feeds.title: Towne Barre Blog
feeds.description: Our mission at Towne Barre is to create a community that is inclusive and accessible to all. We truly believe that the classes we offer at Towne Barre promote not only physical health, but a mind-body connection like no other. Given our experience in the field, we feel that the combination of Barre and Pilates, performed two to three times a week, is a perfect recipe for overall wellness. Browse through our articles to know more about barre, pilates, our workshops and more!

feeds.title: BarreAmped Blog
feeds.description: Created by international fitness celebrity and former Lotte Berk Method instructor Suzanne Bowen, BarreAmped is the result of more than 13 years of physiological study and client observations by one of America's top fitness talents. Explore our blog to know more about Barre training, healthy recipes, our workshops and more!

feeds.title: NuPower Yoga+Barre Blog
feeds.description: Everyone is welcome. Whether it's your first time in a yoga or barre class or your 100th, you'll find a community that knows your name and loves seeing you walk through the door each day! We are committed to being a safe and nurturing space of connection, growth, healing, and heart.

feeds.title: The Barre Blog
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to a barre-inspired life. A blog for barre fanatics. This is your one-stop shop for everything barre-inspired.
